# Issue #83 — Progress Since Last Review

Implements [the activity-section request](https://github.com/sebastiaofv/TeamOs/issues/83#issuecomment-6756920894). All widgets now share one Project Overview; Sprint Analytics keeps its existing behavior.

## English walkthrough

Import `us-9-sections.board.json`, select Dashboard and set Start date to **24/10/2026**, End date to **31/10/2026**.

1. **Activity Summary** and the shared Workitem detail follow Workitem Status in the single Project Overview section. Activity Summary uses one third of the desktop grid; Started, Completed, In Progress and Testing Workitems flow in the same grid. At smaller widths the grid wraps. Detail widgets retain preset heights.
2. Activity Summary shows **3 Started**, **2 Completed**, **6 In Progress**, **0 Testing** (the legacy Testing-named state belongs to the execution category). Each indicator updates the integrated Workitem details widget; no bottom list is ever rendered.
3. Started contains Story **910** (24/10), independent Task **911** (25/10), and Bug **914** (28/10). The fixture's legacy title “Bug excluded from activity lists” is retained to expose the changed inclusion rule. Child Task **913** and Epics are excluded. Moving 911 to Testing on 26/10 does not count as another start.
4. Completed contains **910** and **912**, both on 30/10. The event for 912 at 23:59:59.999 belongs to that day. Each compact row shows a small ID above the title, type/status dots and responsible-person initials with the full name on hover. Dates and table headers are absent. Titles truncate with their full text on hover. Clicking the ID opens its normal detail, editable for writable projects.
5. In Progress includes only execution states, excluding the Testing category at the selected End date, including work already executing before Start. Workflow status dots retain the recorded name and color. Lists show every workitem and scroll internally at the preset height. Only Activity Summary shows counts; there is no View All button.
6. Set Start to 26/10: only Bug 914 remains in Started. Set End to 29/10: Completed becomes empty and Story 910 is still In Progress. Repeated starts/completions count a workitem once per indicator; the qualifying date is its first transition within the selected period.
7. In **Visible sections**, use the Visible/Hidden lists to show/hide all widgets and drag and drop or arrows to reorder them. With a writable project, all widgets’ visibility/order are saved in the project file, restored on reopening and available to everyone using that file. **Reset to Default** restores the default order with the four independent lists hidden. This extension does not change workitems and preserves the reporting rules. Read-only/historical consultation supports a local layout without writing to the project.
8. A period with recorded history but no qualifying transitions shows zero and a quiet empty message. Starting before 15/10 displays a partial-history warning. No baseline means Started/Completed/Testing are unavailable (N/A), while current In Progress can still be consulted. An End date before the first baseline never substitutes today's data. Restores, baseline contents and workflow edits do not invent activity.
9. Repeat in English/Portuguese, light/dark, at desktop and 390px widths. Lists scroll internally; the page has no horizontal overflow. Keyboard users can activate IDs, summary indicators and layout controls. Changing dates recomputes the selected activity and clears obsolete arbitrary selections. Consultation and drill-down alone leave the project file untouched. The standalone HTML supports the same behavior offline.

## Validação em português

Importar o mesmo ficheiro e selecionar **24/10/2026–31/10/2026**. Confirmar totais **3 / 2 / 6 / 0** no Resumo de atividade. O último zero é esperado: neste ficheiro legado o estado com nome Testing pertence à categoria de execução. Num workflow com categoria Testing, registar entradas nessa categoria dentro e fora do período; confirmar deduplicação, inclusão de workitems antigos e dos que saíram entretanto de Testing, com o estado atual. As restantes listas preservam o estado na data de fim. Todas apresentam todos os workitems com scroll interno, ID sobre o título truncado, pontos de cor do tipo/estado e avatar com iniciais/nome completo em hover. Não existem cabeçalhos, datas, contadores no título nem Ver todos; o ID abre o detalhe.

Em **Secções visíveis**, confirmar adição, remoção e reordenação dos cinco widgets. A configuração é guardada no ficheiro partilhado do projeto e mantém-se ao reabrir; **Repor predefinições** recupera a ordem inicial. Em modo de consulta, a alteração é apenas local. Confirmar mensagens distintas para ausência de atividade, histórico parcial e histórico indisponível, bem como funcionamento em claro/escuro, mobile e standalone offline.

Automated coverage: `tests/unit/dashboardOverview.test.ts`, `tests/unit/dashboardActivityLayout.test.ts`, `tests/e2e/dashboardSections.test.ts`, `tests/e2e/dashboard.test.ts` and `tests/dashboard-sections.visual.test.ts`.

Testing counts actual transitions into the Testing workflow category once per workitem in the selected period, including workitems created earlier and ones that subsequently leave Testing. It displays current workflow status; the other lists preserve end-date status. Category edits, baselines and restores do not fabricate transitions.

The shared detail starts with a hint to select Activity Summary or Sprint Workitems, and adopts the selected indicator/Sprint name as its heading. Project, phase, milestone and Sprint selections also use it exclusively. The widget fits at least three workitems before scrolling. Open risks, deliverables and decisions use the same compact-list approach. Full widget layout configuration is stored as version 2 in the existing dashboardActivity extension; version 1 activity layouts migrate preserving their saved choices.
